routes.retired_because: One point-mass saving exp(-L^c) cannot absorb exp(O(N log L)) when N is of order L^0.52 and c < 0.47.

C9000011.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 011 (Prime-factor statistics of $`p-1`$.; papers: Weighted dilation graphs, smooth shifted primes and totient fibers; The Poisson-Dirichlet law for prime predecessors; Prime Predecessors with an Even Number of Prime Factors; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_MS_RESTORATION.statement: For every cutoff and repeated values, birth-local equality constraints preserve factorial adjoints and imply abs(Z_distinct) <= sum_r c(A,r) min(U delta^r,V Q^min(N,2r)), under the explicit factorized fresh-law, positive Schur and signed-edge hypotheses; this includes both WDG rank bounds.

C_MS_LOCAL.statement: Birth-only local multipliers preserve symmetric memory functions, factorial adjoints and both weighted absolute bounds, including repeated values and all memory sizes.

C_MS_INDEX_BOUNDARY.statement: Arbitrary old-index multipliers need not preserve symmetric functions, although absolute domination and symmetric compression still preserve the Schur bounds.

C_MS_FRESH.statement: Chronological dependent fresh births give one maximal-atom factor each in the positive path majorant, uniformly in retained pivot values.

C_MS_RANK.statement: A rank-r equality collection affects at most 2r edges; its total absolute coefficient is the coefficient of t^r in the product of (1+jt), j=0,...,A-1.

C_MS_FORMAL_CORE.statement: The delimited quantified core: equivariant choice sums, complex birth-batch averaging, arbitrary-multiplicity factorial identities over every characteristic-zero field, exact real fresh-block atom savings, affected-address count and scalar rank-loss bound.

C_WDG_TOTIENT.statement: For every epsilon > 0, infinitely many n have g(n) > n^(1-epsilon).

C_WDG_SMOOTH.statement: For fixed 0 < delta < 1/4 there are at least x^(1-o(1)) primes 2x < p <= 5x with P+(p-1) <= x^delta.

C_WDG_IDEAL.statement: The residual ideal operator has arbitrarily strong fixed logarithmic norm decay under the prescribed hypotheses (thm:ideal).

C_WDG_TRANSFER_INPUTS.statement: Root replacement, the exact memory identity, truncation, rare transfers and clean Fourier reduction supply the other local-transference inputs.

C_WDG_TRANSFERENCE.statement: For fixed E there is an ideal accuracy independent of the later fixed J giving the averaged physical moment bound L^(-EN) (thm:transference).

C_WDG_SHIFT.statement: The lifted shift-correlation estimate follows from the ideal and transference contracts with the stated discrepancy hypotheses (thm:shift).

C_WDG_TYPEII.statement: The prescribed Type-II bilinear estimate holds with its range and coefficient hypotheses (thm:typeii).

C_WDG_EXTRACTION.statement: Candidate mass, Type-I control, Type-II control, congruence distribution and sieve removal imply the smooth shifted-prime theorem.

C_PD_MAIN.statement: For every fixed k and bounded continuous F, the ordinary prime average of the k largest normalized factors of p-1 converges to the Poisson-Dirichlet expectation (thm:main).

C_PD_INTERIOR.statement: Interior factorial-moment asymptotics plus endpoint and sorting control imply the ranked Poisson-Dirichlet law.

C_PD_CORRELATION.statement: The two-sided marked correlation estimate holds on the prescribed interior slot ranges (thm:two-sided), using the imported graph and ideal estimates and its determinant-memory analysis.

C_PD_DETERMINANT_MEMORY.statement: The separate determinant-memory minor-arc moment estimate holds (prop:minor-moment); only its local equivariance convention is compared in this mission.

C_PARITY_MAIN.statement: Infinitely many primes p have p-1 squarefree with an even number of prime factors (thm:main).

C_PARITY_TRANSFERENCE.statement: The imported local-transference and endpoint-pairing contract gives O(X L^(-E+2C3)) under the stated support and mark-independence hypotheses (prop:sh:transference).

C_PARITY_EXTRACTION.statement: The parity prime-slot correlation and Type-II estimate, congruence distribution, weight mass and imported block-sieve/proxy estimates imply the parity theorem.
